empty-blocked-description: To block someone, open the menu on one of their posts and choose Block.
empty-muted-description: To mute someone, open the menu on one of their posts and choose Mute.
error-description: Check your connection and try again.
no-match-description: Try a different name or handle.
page-description: Everyone you blocked or muted, newest first. Unblock or unmute them here.
signed-out: Sign in to see who you blocked or muted.
unblock-description: They will be able to follow and message you again.
undo-failed: Couldn't undo. Mute them again from a post.
